'''Pawel Szymanski''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Krakow tournament]] in October 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]] and [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|racing WYS]], according to Wojciech Wisniewski's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3068">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-21-krakow-poland-10-20-01d3068/ krakow-poland-10-20-01], DeckTech (Wojciech "Hipo" Wisniewski, 21 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-21-krakow-poland-10-20-01d3068/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
